ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pigmentation to low-intensity black/mottled pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the upper-medial zones of both lobes. Extensive dark mottling and discrete circular black spots (10-30 pixel diameter) are overlaid on the white regions. Solid black pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge and dominates the lower peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 30 degrees and a vertical pixel depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Serrations exhibit sharp triangular peaks with an average pixel amplitude of 20-30 units, most pronounced towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edge sweep with an acute upward curve at the lobe tips; the trailing edge follows a wide concave arc from the median notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular clusters concentrated in the white fields of both lobes. Left lobe contains a cluster of 6 distinct spots near the tip; right lobe exhibits a sparse field of over 12 non-aligned circular markings.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear rake marks (linear pixel disruptions) located on the upper-right lobe, approximately 300 pixels right of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (high-contrast white/grey textured clusters) visible at the extreme distal tips and along the outer leading edges of both lobes. Significant jagged irregularity on the far-right lobe tip consistent with minor edge trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of trailing edge serration provides a highly unique fractal-like boundary compared to typical smooth-edged fluke samples.
